Jamison, on the strange feats of magic at Tony's house results in the Major taking his son to Dr. Bellows, the base psychiatrist. Bellows tells Custer he believes his story, and asks him to keep a close watch on Tony. A policeman catches Dr. Bellows and Custer peering into Tony's window and takes them inside for identification. While Bellows is telling Tony that Custer believes he has seen them levitate, Jeannie causes him to do so. Bellows bows out, feeling he has stumbled on a top-secret aerospace project.Tony voices his nervousness to Jeannie about being spied on by Custer. When Custer disappears, Tony accuses Jeannie of turning him into nothing. Angered, Jeannie leaves. Later, when Custer comes back, having spent the day at a carnival, Tony penitently begins searching for Jeannie. He is sure Jeannie has joined a carnival act and starts a riot at the sideshow when he mistakes a veiled woman for Jeannie. Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E12
programme.desc: Jeannie is annoyed when Diane Rodney, a friend of Tony's, returns to town, determined to resume their old relationship. As a result, when Jeannie runs into Roger, while driving Tony's car, she accepts his invitation to dinner. Unaware that Jeannie is Roger's date, Tony instructs his friend in the fine art of courtship. Later, when Jeannie tells him she doesn't know her date's name, Tony begins to worry. When Diane arrives, Tony drags her all over town searching for Jeannie. The two couples finally meet at a nightclub. Alone with Jeannie, Tony demands she return home. Jeannie tells him she is going to listen to Roger's records.At Roger's apartment, Jeannie wards off all his attempts at romance. She leaves shortly before Tony pounds on the door looking for her. Tony points out to Roger all the mistakes he would be making if he married her. Convinced, Roger admits Tony has saved him from making a fool of himself. Jeannie is overjoyed by Tony's concern for her. Tony replies that, after all, he is only human.

To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Seasons of the Forest
programme.desc: No place on Earth is more changeable than the seasonal forest, undergoing radical transformations year after year. These adaptations to the seasons are what makes our woodlands so varied and dynamic a cycle of interwoven behaviors and practices ticking away like a Swiss watch to rejuvenate the landscape ready for the new year. To fully understand the stories of the great woodlands spend a year among the trees, watching the energetic and vibrant changes that mark the seasons of the forest.

programme.title: Rivers Lifeblood
programme.desc: Rivers flow like veins across the Earth, a lifeline to countless ecosystems. Since the dawn of time they've fuelled the development of animal and human life alike. Habitats in constant flux, they change with the seasons, gradually transforming over time. As we run the river's course, we meet the spectacular animals who depend on it. These waterways are as much as lifeblood to this wildlife as they are to us. They deserve our respect and protection – they're our lifeblood and we must keep them flowing.

programme.title: Manatees on the Move
programme.desc: Manatees, sea cows, these gentle giants go by several names. They were once thought to be beautiful mermaids that could lure sailors to their deaths, though they probably won't win too many beauty contests. To retain their weight, manatees need to eat for 8 hours and consume 8% of their bodyweight every day. And keeping eating also means keeping moving! Thanks to their tolerance of human visitors, manatees have mates everywhere, working tirelessly to ensure they roam the world for generations to come.

The breath-taking camerawork for this documentary received the Columbus Film Award.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: Amazing Iran
programme.desc: For the Iranian Turkmen a wedding is one of most important social events in their culture and is still celebrated according to old nomadic tradition. The Turkmen Steppe, the country of a thousand mountains, is a tribute to the hidden treasure that is Iran. Home to a proud nation with a majestic history, we show the freedom of a nomadic life, encounter the wild nature of the people and discover old traditions like the Turkmen wedding. Breathtaking sceneries create a mysticism that transports viewers into the realm of divinity while exposing a world caught between tradition and modernity - nomadism and sedentarism. Weddings in Iran are primarily arrangements between families and the product of lengthy negotiations. Even though many customs are purely symbolic, they still reflect the great significance as a rite of transition for the newlyweds and their families. The life of the Turkmen housewife revolves around weddings – first her own, later those of her children. Raising healthy, capable daughters and sons searching for possible partners mediating contact negotiating each betrothal with the family of the intended shouldering the wedding arrangements and the observance of customs and traditions – the responsibility for all of that falls to the mother. Though the Turkmen daughters and sons of today do insist on having their say, love, affection, trust and the like are still not the decisive criteria in making a match. The main consideration is not the subjective happiness of the couple but the happiness, stability and honor of each of their families as a whole. So it is still not uncommon for the bride and groom to be virtual strangers on their wedding day. The nuptials as a ritual of transition mark a series of profound changes – especially in the life of the bride. Once married, she leaves her family and her home village to take her new place within the family of the groom.

programme.title: Amazing Isfahan
programme.sub-title: Paradise in the Heart of Iran
programme.desc: Take a look at this natural beauty. Isfahan – the Florence of Persia, the blue pearl of Iran. The city in the heart of Iran is the most charismatic city in the country and often uttered in the same breath as Bagdad, Constantinople or Cairo. The former capital of the Persian Safavid Empire has long since lost the status of cosmopolitan city, but it still radiates a cosmopolitan charm of which the inhabitants are extremely proud. With its Iranian and Persian national consciousness, Isfahan emits a form of comeliness that attracts people near and far. Following the 30-year-old carpet dealer Shanty as he tries to establish a business for himself and his fiancée Nina, we discover the soul of the city with mesmeric shots, intimate portraits and true to life portrayals of daily life. For 120 years his family has been dealing with noble Persian carpets, but Shanty dreams of a modern coffee shop, driven by a youthful eagerness to experiment and with passion for the new. In the cozy little espresso bar on the city's famous Imam Square Shanty's barista conjures up the best créma in Isfahan while Pink Floyd, The Grateful Death and Led Zeppelin boom from the loudspeakers nothing new in Berlin or Paris but almost revolutionary here. In intimate pictures, we accompany the youngest son of an old Isfahan family through his bulging everyday life and see how many young Iranians try to unite the culture and traditions of their country with the present.

programme.title: Food Unknown

Jonathan lands in Manila to discover the top chefs are well aware of the issue and, following their advice, he launches off on an expedition to find part of the solution. Driving from headhunting tribal villages, to step-back-in-time colonial towns, to restaurants in the shadow of the American military behemoth an intriguing story slowly pieces together. In the dense jungle one treasure stays buried while another comes literally out of the woodwork. But danger always lurks.. zombie moray eels, landslide prone passes, and forbidden fields behind the rice paddies.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks

programme.title: Only One Can Remain
programme.desc: On the island, Lloyd learns that his father used to train under the deceitful Master Chen and when the Ninja meet the playfully deceitful ruler, they realize they are in a tournament where “Only one can remain.” On the island, Lloyd learns his father used to train under the deceitful Master Chen. They meet the playfully deceitful ruler who tells them they are in a tournament where ‘Only one can remain'. When they are spoiled by their posh quarters, they are surprised to find the game is already afoot: Last person to find a Jade Blade is out. After an epic battle of elemental powers, Kai steals the last one from Karlof, who is kicked out of the tournament through a trap door leading to the unknown. Later that night, the Ninja go in search for Zane but come across an underground temple where Chen and his Anacondrai Worshippers steal Karlof's power. Is this a fighting tournament, or a ploy to steal everyone's power?

programme.title: Versus
programme.desc: In order find Zane, the Ninja stay in the tournament to get past the first round but Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole. In order to find Zane and get to the bottom of Chen's mysterious plot the Ninja need to stay in the tournament and get past the first round. Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole. Meanwhile, new Titanium Ninja Zane is locked in a dungeon and has a nightmare about a ferocious Ice Dragon. Guided by the voice of Pixal, he embraces his new technology and escapes his cell, only to find Pixal hasn't fared as well. Though she has no body, he inputs her CPU into his, uniting the two. In an attempt to prevent Jay versus Cole, the Ninja enlist the Master of Mind to help, but are unable to prevent the inevitable. In a gladiator battle, Jay and Cole put aside their feud to throw the match --enraging Chen to send Cole down the mysterious trap door. Lastly, Nya sees Zane's beacon is working again and is on the hunt for them.

programme.title: Winds Of Change
programme.desc: Kai promises to watch over Lloyd when Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain– but when Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission... only to discover it's a trap from a GHOST who's escaped the Cursed Realm. After the Ninja save a small fishing village, Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain but Kai promises to watch over him. When Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission... only it's a trap from a GHOST who's escaped the Cursed Realm. When the Ninja's powers mysteriously disappear, they return to the Tea Farm and are attacked by Lloyd, who is possessed by the spirit of Moro, the Master of Wind! After a harrowing escape on the Bounty, Wu tells the Ninja they weren't his first pupils!

programme.title: Ghost Story
programme.desc: When Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja – and the Ninja discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, leaving them to crash. When the dust settles, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja. They discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. In order to save Lloyd and get their powers back, they set off to find the first clue – the scroll to the lost martial art of ‘Airjitzu'. On their way to get it, they have a run in with one of Moro's ghost generals Wraythe, and discover water is the key to stopping them. Meanwhile, Nya discovers a family secret – her mother was a Water Ninja and with training, she could be one too.

programme.title: Saturday Knight Fever
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters catching a cold means trouble for the NEXO-Knights when he can create an entirely new kind of “snotty” monster. King and Queen Halbert have journeyed to the town of Cleanington to open the brand new Scrubbery Barn at the invitation of Roger the Scrubber (seen in 104.) Meanwhile, the Book of Monsters drags Jestro to Snottingham – one of the coldest places in Knighton where everyone coughs, has a runny nose and is generally under-the-weather. The BOM demands that Jestro feed him a “snotheiser” ball which will probably make him sick. The BOM explains that if he is sick, he may just produce a whole new breed of magical monsters … some that the knights would NEVER expect. The BOM gets sick and starts coughing up phlegm globlins and bloblins. The Knights arrive, alerted to what they think is an attack on the town by Snottingham's mayor, Hack Coughmeier. The sickened, sneezy, snotty monsters infect the knights and, more importantly, the knights' NEXO-Shields. Now their NEXO-Powers are infected. As they try to download something to fight the monsters, they realize the powers they get are off strange, infected versions of their powers. The knights drive Jestro and his snot monsters off and they turn in for the night. And, overnight, they all get sick. Meanwhile, the BOM order a nice, hot lava bath…he'll feel fine by morning. But the knights wake-up with colds and they feel terrible. Ava and Merlok 2.0 thinks it will pass in a day or two…it's just a typical Snottingham cold. Each knight gets sick in their own funny way and their illnesses play right into Jestro and the BOM's hands: they're headed to Cleanington to kidnap the king! The citizens of the ultra-clean city hate the sight of monsters, but then feel caught in between when the sick, sneezy, snotty knights arrive on their Fortrex. The fight goes terribly for the knights. They try to download the Nexo-power “Glorious Griffon” but instead get just feathers. So they improvise and tickle the monsters! Ava finally comes up with a way to use some anti-virus tools on their NEXO-Shields and just as Jestro is about to take the king and queen away, the NEXO-Knights get their normal powers back! They defeat Jestro and save the king and queen.

programme.title: Open Mike Knight
programme.desc: The Book of Betrayal leads Jestro and his Monsters to Funnyton – the funnies town in the kingdom. When they Knights arrive to capture him, they discover (to their shock) that Jestro and the Book of Monsters are now the town's top comedians! Jestro and his monsters are in attack formation moving to pillage the town of Funnyton. But when they arrive, ready to tear into the place, they see that nobody's in town. Then, they hear…laughter?! The entire town is there listening to a stand-up comic JOKES KNIGHTLY. He's hilarious. He commands such power, such attention, and such loyalty. Jestro and the BOM decide they must become funny. They order all kinds of book on comedy from Spamazon: books on parody, irony, insult humor, slapstick, satire, knock-knock jokes, elephant jokes, “my monster is so fat” jokes, etc. They work-up a ventriloquist act with the BOM sitting on Jestro's lap. They start doing their act and, surprisingly, they're funny. They're very funny. The Fortrex arrives and the knights rush out, ready for battle. They fight through a string of monsters just outside the town, but discover they're only working as “bouncers” to keep too many people out of the comedy club. (“Sorry, you guys aren't on the list.”) The knights hear loud laughs and head there. In the club, they discover the town isn't being held hostage, they're in the show voluntarily having a great time. And…Jestro and the BOM are funny. Meanwhile, during the show, Jokes Knightly decides he'll steal the BOM and Jestro's act. During the intermission at the comedy show, Clay comes backstage to talk to Jestro. Maybe, Clay says, this shows that Jestro doesn't have to be bad…he is funny, like Clay always said he was. Meanwhile, Jokes Knightly steals the BOM and Jestro can't find it. He panics. Clay encourages him…go on stage alone, be funny…he can do it! Jestro goes out and is funny on his own he hits all his punchlines, he gets big laughs he starts to see that Clay is right. The BOM sees that Jokes Knightly has a “joke book” that turns out to be the BOOK OF BETRAYAL. That's how Mike Knight has become so funny – by stealing everyone's material! BOM calls in Magmar, who saves him from Mike Knight AND takes the Book of Betrayal. As Jestro comes off-stage to great applause, the BOM tells him they have the Book of Betrayal. The BOM calls in Magmar and his monsters and they start a fight as Clay comes to Jestro's defense and calls on the other Knights for backup. A big battle ensues that destroys the comedy club in Funnyton. The Knights win and drive-off Magmar, the monsters and the BOM. As they retreat, the BOM looks around: “Where's my Jestro?!” Jestro sneaked away during the fight and is in a nearby forest with…the Book of Betrayal.

programme.title: The Fortrex And The Furious
programme.desc: In a massive chase around Knighton, the NEXO-Knights attempt to keep the Book of Betrayal out of the Book of Monster's grip. But the evil book is persistent. Will he get the final piece of his evil puzzle? We finally REVEAL that Jestro has given the Book of Betrayal to…Clay. He tells Clay what it is and how Mike Knight used it. And it seems that the Book of Monsters believed it to be the final ingredient in some ‘Master Plan.” Suddenly, they realize Monsters – led by Magmar and the super-mad Book of Monster – are after them! Clay retreats with Jestro and the Book of Betrayal to rendezvous with the other Knights at the Fortrex. The Fortrex isn't fast enough they'll need their own vehicles. They decide that they need to split up and go in multiple directions to make the monsters expend their resources on a chase. It's a huge chase, being covered like a crazy news event by the Knighton News Network. We see a montage of the monsters stopping and capturing all the Knights vehicles: Aaron, Macy, Lance…finally Axl. However, as they do, they realize that the Knights have used Squirebots in Jestro Fan Jester hats (from the vendor at the comedy club in 108) as decoys. They think Axl has the Book of Betrayal in his BRICK containment unit, but it turns out to be the Ned Knightly Comic from episode 203. The Monsters finally corner Clay, who has the real Jestro and Book of Betrayal in his sword vehicle. Before Clay can protest, Jestro pushes the launch button and fires off Clay in the vehicle's rocket sword. The monsters race off with Jestro, leaving the shocked Clay fearing for his friend. Now, Magmar tells the Book of Monsters, they only need to get BOB. Clay makes his way back to the Fortrex and tells what has happened. They decide they must get to the Redoubt of Ruination in the Lava Lands and try to save Jestro. Meanwhile, we see, INTERCUT, a scene where Merlok 2.0 and the Book of Monsters explain the Books of Evil, how they were created and what the BOM will use them for. Merlok, back in the day, split the evil MONSTRUX into 10 magic books to keep him from ever being a threat. Only, he didn't destroy the books…and now the BOM has them and Monstrux can come back into the world! Meanwhile, the BOM has set up the huge, ceremonial arena at their HQ so they can have the ceremony to bring Monstrux back into the world. Jestro realizes he's been a pawn of the Book of Monsters. Jestro says he'll never get the Book of Betrayal…the Knights have it. In the last scene, we see Clay taking the Book of Betrayal from the Fortrex, climbing into his vehicle and driving towards…the Redoubt of Ruination! Has the Book of Betrayal worked its evil magic on him?!

programme.title: Kingdom Of Heroes
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form. Can the NEXO-Knights and Merlok 2.0 stop the greatest threat they've ever faced? Or will the kingdom be plunged into darkness…forever. The Redoubt of Ruination readies the final ceremony to call forth MONSTRUX, the arch-necromancer of the past. Clay, holding the Book of Betrayal walks to the gates of the spooky place. Inside, Clay hears strange…singing and music. It's like a twisted Broadway show of some kind. Meanwhile, the Knights all realize Clay is gone and so is the Book of Betrayal. Macy says Clay must be up to something. They have to trust him and, more importantly, they have to find him. At the Redoubt of Ruination the ceremony has already begun! The Book of Monsters wants the final ceremony that calls forth Monstrux to be like a really great show! The BOM then barfs up all the BOOKS OF EVIL into their places around Jestro. He's just missing the BOOK OF BETRAYAL, which Clay has. Clay says he'll trade the book for Jestro. The BOM immediately agrees to the deal and sets Jestro free. Then, Monsters grab-up Clay, restrain him, and put him in Jestro's place on the sacrifice stone. From outside, they're interrupted by the sounds of battle the Knights have arrived on the Fortrex and are attacking the Redoubt of Ruination. In the confusion, Jestro slips away. The BOM lets loose with a powerful protection spell to keep the Knights out as he starts with the ceremony…he's going to bring Monstrux out and remanifest him in Clay's body! Jestro is able to escape the Redoubt and make his way to the Knights, who can't seem to battle their way in. It's a race against time as the Knights try to get in and save Clay. As the Knights get in, they see that the crazy BOM is absorbing all the Books of Evil, one-by-one. He grows BIGGER and BIGGER! Macy calls for NEXO-Power…but it's not enough! The gigantic Book of Monsters sucks down the final book, the Book of Betrayal! He looms over Clay, about to consume him, too, and make him into Monstrux! Suddenly, Robin appears carrying TECHKALIBER…he tosses it to Clay. Just as the huge Book of Monsters falls on Clay, he holds up Techkaliber and Merlok 2.0 is there…his full power in the sword. Clay sticks the sword into the Book of Monster's huge mouth. BOOM! There's a BIG, MAGICAL EXPLOSION! As we cut back inside, we see the Book of Monsters is gone. The Knights release Clay and he thanks them and Jestro for saving him. Jestro thanks them all for saving him and seeing the good in him. WE DISSOLVE TO: The JoustDome. In a final ceremony the King and Queen reward the knights and congratulate them for keeping the kingdom safe. There are speeches, happiness and friendship. And Jestro even does a bit that's funny. At the very end we see a hint of something…Monstrux and the Book of Monsters are still out there.

However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Maata Ki Mahima
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Duniyadari
programme.desc: In today's Duniyadari, we discuss the meeting of PM Narendra Modi, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping at the SCO Summit amid changing global geopolitics. We also look at the Iran-US conflict, tensions over the Strait of Hormuz and India's diplomatic challenges.

programme.title: Kharcha Pani
programme.desc: LIC Housing Finance, along with Canara Bank and Union Bank of India, has moved NCLAT against the NCLT-approved repayment plan for Subhash Chandra, which proposes paying just ₹6.25 crore against admitted creditor claims of ₹22,000 crore . The dissenting lenders have also alleged that five entities linked to Chandra's family controlled 61.78% of the voting share and helped push through the plan .

programme.title: Rajdhani
programme.desc: The murder of Haryanvi singer Ankit Baliyan in Shamli has triggered a political war over the Jat vote in western UP, with Akhilesh Yadav questioning the police encounter and Jayant Chaudhary visiting the family . The BJP has defended the action, accusing the SP of shielding criminals .

programme.title: Sehat
programme.desc: Can a growing waistline increase your cancer risk? We discuss the link between belly fat, visceral fat, and obesity-related cancers—plus brain health tips for your 30s and whether gut microbiome tests are actually worth it.

programme.title: UP Bulletin
programme.desc: Akhilesh Yadav has announced booth-level campaigning from September 1, intensifying the political battle ahead of the 2027 UP elections. The episode also covers the closure of 26,000 schools, the AI-generated video controversy involving Yogi Adityanath, and the Ankit Baliyan murder case.

programme.title: The Cinema Show
programme.desc: Salman Khan's 'Karna' is set to go on floors next year, while Yash's 'Toxic' faces legal trouble despite earning ₹285 crore worldwide . We also cover Tom Hanks' 'The Comeback', Tom Cruise's 'Days of Thunder 2', and 'Mirzapur: The Movie' getting an A certificate with cuts.

programme.title: samosa Critics
programme.desc: Kareena Kapoor Khan and Prithviraj Sukumaran face off in Meghna Gulzar's Daayra, a crime thriller based on true events that questions justice, accountability, and the limits of the law. Does Kareena's intense performance give us another memorable cop character? Watch our trailer breakdown.

programme.title: Zero Cricket Knowledge
programme.desc: Pakistan's batting struggles continued at Lord's as they crashed to a 194-run defeat against England, conceding the series 2-0. Ollie Robinson was the star with match figures of 8/35, while Saud Shakeel's fighting 97 was the only resistance in a target of 389.

programme.title: Aasan Bhasha Mein
programme.desc: How are some Indian Instagram creators earning lakhs every month through paid subscriptions? We break down Instagram's subscription model, follower and subscriber patterns, pricing and estimated earnings of popular creators.

programme.title: Tarikh
programme.desc: How did reservation in India begin, and what role did Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj play in shaping Dr. B.R. Ambedkar's journey? This episode traces the history of reservation, from Shahu Maharaj's 1902 policy to the Poona Pact and Constituent Assembly debates.

programme.title: Daily Video
programme.desc: A light-green house in Nepal's flood-ravaged Nuwakot district stands almost intact while surrounding buildings were swept away—and experts believe its RCC frame, reinforced steel, and strategic location helped it resist the massive side pressure of the Trishuli river flood. The viral footage shows the house anchored on solid rock, unlike weaker structures built on sandy foundations.

programme.title: Daily Video
programme.desc: Nepal Police successfully recovered gold worth NPR 50 crore and cash worth NPR 1.5 crore from a flood-submerged bank branch in Nuwakot after an eight-hour operation . The death toll from Nepal's devastating flash floods has crossed 900, with thousands still missing and fresh flood warnings issued for the Bhote Koshi River .

programme.title: Daily Video
programme.desc: A school principal in Nepal saved 1,643 students' lives by evacuating them just minutes before a flash flood completely washed away their school building. Rajendra Dawadi received a warning call about rising waters and immediately rang the school bell, rushing all students to higher ground before the Tribhuvan Trishuli Secondary School was swept away by debris .

programme.title: LIVE GURBANI FROM SACHKHAND SRI HARMANDIR SAHIB, AMRITSAR
programme.desc: Live Gurbani Kirtan from Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib on GTC Punjabi Television brings viewers a sacred spiritual experience directly from one of the most revered historical Gurudwaras of Sikhism, located in the heart of Delhi. This live telecast offers devotees the divine resonance of Gurbani Kirtan, performed by esteemed Ragis, filling homes with peace, devotion, and spiritual reflection. Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib stands as a powerful symbol of supreme sacrifice and unwavering faith, marking the martyrdom of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, who laid down his life for the protection of religious freedom and human rights. Through this live broadcast, GTC Punjabi Television connects Sangat across the globe to the serene atmosphere of the Gurudwara, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in Naam Simran, Shabad Kirtan, and the timeless wisdom of Gurbani. The soulful renditions inspire inner calm, strengthen spiritual connection, and spread the universal message of love, equality, and humility as taught by the Sikh Gurus.

programme.title: Gurmat Vichar
programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life's challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

programme.title: Shabad Amrit

Designed to create a serene and uplifting atmosphere, Shabad Amrit offers viewers a moment of calm amidst daily life, connecting them with spirituality through melodious renditions and meaningful lyrics. Rooted in devotion and reverence, the slot serves as a spiritual pause—where music becomes prayer and faith finds its voice.

Designed for music lovers of all ages, Desi Beatz turns every moment into a celebration, whether it's party anthems, romantic hits, or viral sensations. programme.title: Umeed India
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Anya Kahaniyaan
programme.desc: Raja Rasoi Aur Anya Kahaniyaan is a culinary history show that explores the food of the royals and their erstwhile states. The show takes it's viewers through an amazing journey of anecdotes, folktales, architecture, art, history and landscape and delves into the unique customs and traditions of the various provinces. All these culminate into beautiful renditions of the recipes unique to those regions. This new season of Raja Rasoi aur Anya Kahaniyaan focuses on the royal families as protagonists and explores their personal stories and journeys that shaped their present day food practices.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Way Back Home

programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.desc: The turbocharged three-litre flat-six in the new 911 GTS delivers 353 kW (480 PS). Maximum torque is 570 Nm, an increase of 20 Nm over its predecessor. Zero to 100 km/h takes just 3.3 seconds (911 Carrera 4 GTS: Fuel consumption combined (NEDC) 10.5 – 9.7 l/100 km, Fuel consumption combined (WLTP) 11.4 – 10.6 l/100 km, CO₂ emissions combined (NEDC) 240 – 222 g/km, CO₂ emissions combined (WLTP) 259 – 240 g/km) in the 911 Carrera 4 GTS Coupé with the eight-speed Porsche dual-clutch transmission (PDK): three tenths faster than its predecessor. programme.title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID. Buzz
programme.sub-title: How was the electric Microbus created
programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. Also new: the ‘Memory Function' for automated parking on a previously saved route.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: 2022 Peugeot 308
programme.desc: The sixth generation Opel/Vauxhall Astra and third generation Peugeot 308 are both based on the Stellantis EMP2 platform and, unsurprisingly, score very similarly across all four areas of assessment. Both the offset test and the full-width crash test highlighted marginal chest injury protection for average male and small female drivers, and neither car was equipped with a centre airbag for far-side crash protection, a countermeasure which is increasingly common on modern cars. Both cars offer plenty of crash avoidance technology but do not include some of the latest advancements introduced in the market. The cars' four-star ratings apply also to their PHEV variants.

programme.desc: A sizzling take on barbecue traditions where spice rubs, char, and glaze create rich flavor. Each dish delivers juicy tenderness and smoky depth, creating that familiar BBQ spirit and crowd-pleasing comfort.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Chocolate on the barbecue? That's right. Chef Spencer Watts kicks off this episode as he grills a crispy coconut-cacao crust and serves it with sweet chili dipping sauce. Chocolate is the not-so-secret ingredient in Spencer's Grilled Chicken Molé. He grills the chicken legs smothered in the sweet-spicy-salty-nutty-creamy-chocolatey sauce, then finishes it by cooking it slow and low. Next, dark chocolate cocoa powder is in both the rub and the sauce for Chef Watts' favourite pork rib recipe - Cocoa-rubbed Baby Back Ribs. For his final recipe, Spencer takes it to a sweet level with his Chocolate pizza made with chocolate ganache, grilled cherries, with barbeque- caramelized white chocolate crumble over the top.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: In this bacon loving episode, Chef Spencer delivers a tasty Bacon Weave Turkey Breast, which gets injected with beer and spices before being wrapped up in its cozy bacon blanket and sent off to the grill! Next up? A Peameal Bacon Roast with Rosti. This heavy hunk of back bacon gets smoked to flavourful perfection while Chef Watts makes the crispiest golden-fried-to-perfection potato pancake. Then, Spencer whips up a charry, grilled, super decadent, bacon-wrapped and bacon stuffed cheeseburger. Spencer isn't finished with bacon yet! For his final recipe, Spencer stuffs an apple with decadent crispy morsels stuffed along with savoury caramelized onions and melty cheddar cheese.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: This episode kicks off with Spencer's tasty Grilled Caesar Salad. He skillfully piles of char-grilled romaine lettuce wedges and sourdough croutons are topped with tangy dressing, crispy pancetta, and shards of a homemade parmesan tuile. For his next recipe, Spencer whips up Grilled Zucchini Boats that filled with fresh ingredients including orzo pasta, summer veggies, and herbs. Chef Watts loves a good steak and his Grilled Cauliflower Steak is not one to be passed up! Dusted in Middle Eastern Spices, flame roasted and served with chili-spiked, Yemeni 'Skhug' hot sauce and pomegranate seeds. Finally, Spencer steams tender artichokes, stuffing these flowers with breadcrumbs and stretchy-melty cheese, and finishes this delicious dish on the grill.

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Halibut is on the menu for Craig Wong's first stop in this episode of CombiNATION Plates for his Icelandic tribute, the firm, flaky fish is served with Lovage, BeÌarnaise, and Beet Glazed Turnips. Next, it's a Jamaican adventure on a plate featuring whole, soft-shell crab Escovitch, fried, doused in chili vinegar, and served with carrot meringue?! Check out the common ingredient: ice cream! With creamy Skyr style with Blueberries representing Iceland and an Avocado Lime sensation for Jamaica that only Chef Wong could pull off, made in mere moments with liquid nitrogen! The Big Dish is a you-could-only-find-it-here experience Jamaican Jerk Spice Reindeer (yes, you read that right) served with Brown Stew Wild Mushrooms and Salsify.

programme.title: CombiNation Plates

programme.title: Homo Eroticus
programme.desc: Fuggito dalla natia Sicilia, Michele Cannaritta emigra al Nord e si trasferisce in provincia di Bergamo, dove trova lavoro come cameriere per un ricco industriale della zona. Ben presto viene conteso dalla padrona di casa, dalle sue amiche e dalle altre cameriere. Si aprono per lui le porte per una veloce scalata sociale, ma le cose non andranno esattamente come previsto...

programme.title: L'Erotomane
programme.desc: L'avvocato Persichetti è un dirigente di una importante società petrolifera. L'uomo è affetto da una nevrosi che gli impedisce di avere rapporti sessuali soddisfacenti tanto con la moglie Ciccia quanto con la giovane e disinibita amante Claretta. Per tentare di guarire, si affiderà alle cure di uno strano psichiatra, ma senza ottenere grossi risultati.

programme.title: Hot Corn Cine News
programme.desc: Hot Corn Cine News è un appuntamento bisettimanale, nato dall'unione tra LoveTv Channel e The Hot Corn, che racconta tutte le novità del mondo del cinema, tra ospiti, eventi e interviste, prossime uscite in sala e cronache mondane. Ad introdurci in questo mondo di news sulla Settima Arte c'è Sara Scarsella. I cinque nuovi film in concorso a Venezia Johnny Depp sarà Ebenezer Scrooge nel nuovo film Scrooge e gli spiriti del Natale Ryan Gosling sarà il nuovo Ghost Rider intervista al regista Nicola Ragone Tom Holland si prepara a interpretare Fred Astaire. In chiusura, interviste dal Marateale a Massimiliano Caiazzo, Dario Aita e alla vincitrice del contest Young Blood, Aisha Meki.

programme.title: Il boss
programme.desc: Film Cult di Fernando di Leo. Lanzetta, uno spietato killer, si introduce in un cinema durante la proiezione di un film e massacra la gang del boss Antonino Attardi, colpevole di aver accolto tra le sue file Cocchi, un killer della 'Ndrangheta che vende informazioni alla commissione antimafia, e che mira a diventare membro di Cosa Nostra. Ha così inizio una guerra sanguinaria.

programme.title: Il sorriso della iena
programme.desc: Dopo la morte della madre in circostanze ambigue, un'adolescente inizia a sospettare che il suo patrigno, rimasto vedovo da poco, possa essere coinvolto.

programme.title: La donna della domenica
programme.desc: Un Classico del cinema italiano, diretto da Luigi Comencini e interpretato da Marcello Mastroianni e Jean-louis Trintignant. A Torino viene misteriosamente ucciso un architetto. Le indagini portano il commissario Santamaria a indirizzare i suoi sospetti su alcuni esponenti dell'alta società, e in particolare su Anna, moglie di un grosso industriale, e sul suo confidente, un dottore.

programme.title: Gli Anni Ruggenti
programme.desc: In questa splendida commedia diretta da Luigi Zampa, l'assicuratore Omero arriva in una cittadina dove tutti stanno aspettando un funzionario fascista. Scambiato per il gerarca tanto atteso, continua a svolgere il suo lavoro. Omero, nel frattempo, si innamora della figlia di un uomo che ricopre un alto ruolo istituzionale, ma l'arrivo del vero gerarca metterà tutto a rischio.

programme.title: Genitori in blue jeans
programme.desc: Una serie di personaggi della Roma bene degli anni '50 frequenta la rinomata sartoria di Peppino, un uomo che ha respinto tutte le proposte di matrimonio che gli sono state fatte negli anni. Durante un viaggio a Parigi, Peppino conosce una donna e finalmente se ne innamora, ma proprio dopo aver deciso di sposarla viene a scoprire qualcosa di inaspettato.

programme.title: Il Mantenuto
programme.desc: Stefano Garbelli, impiegato romano, viene coinvolto dalla prostituta Daniela, che lo indica come suo protettore per difendersi dai magnaccia. Daniela si finge infermiera, suscitando l'interesse di Stefano. Inconsapevolmente, Stefano diventa il suo protettore agli occhi dei rivali e della polizia, che lo convoca al commissariato insieme agli aggressori.

programme.title: Splendori e Miserie di Madame Royale
programme.desc: Alessio, ex ballerino omosessuale, ha solo due consolazioni, la figlia adottiva e i momenti in cui si traveste con sontuosi abiti femminili e si fa chiamare Madame Royale, durante le festicciole con gli amici. Un giorno la figlia finisce nei guai e un losco commissario promette al ballerino di proscioglierla se accetterà di diventare una spia della polizia.

programme.title: L'ingorgo
programme.desc: Un corteo di macchine procede sempre più lentamente lungo la tangenziale di Roma, sino a che ogni possibilità di movimento si blocca. L`ingorgo durerà 36 ore. Sin dai primi momenti il nervosismo dei viaggiatori è evidente. Quando sfumano le speranze di una veloce soluzione, mancano notizie, si palesano le prime necessità, la tensione sale al massimo e non pochi trascendono. La circostanza permette di scoprire i lati peggiori dell`umanità presente...

programme.title: La grande abbuffata
programme.desc: In una villa fuori Parigi quattro vecchi amici si riuniscono per un week-end abbandonandosi ad un`orgia di cibo e sesso. Uno di loro, Marcello, porta con sé alcune prostitute che disgustate dall`ambiente se ne andranno. Ad un certo punto una maestra va lì per caso con in suoi alunni in visita al giardino della villa, rimane affascinata dai quattro e decide di fare ritorno unendosi a loro nel folle e autodistruttivo fine settimana...

programme.title: L'orchestra rossa
programme.desc: L`orchestra rossa è la più importante rete di spie della seconda guerra mondiale. Si tratta di una storia incredibile ma assolutamente vera, che ricostruisce come un manipolo di audaci non professionisti di diverse nazionalità, senza alcuna esperienza sul campo, sia riuscito a tenere in scacco i nazisti sottraendo informazioni segretissime persino durante le riunioni di Hitler con i suoi generali

programme.title: Aida
programme.desc: Il giovane Radames, condottiero delle truppe egiziane e trionfatore sugli Etiopi nella guerra per il possesso dell`alta valle del Nilo, ottiene dal faraone la liberazione della bellissima schiava Aida, di cui è innamorato, e di suo padre, Amonasro, re degli etiopi. Costretta dall`autorità del padre, Aida induce Radames a rivelare il segreto delle future mosse dell`esercito egiziano.

programme.title: Any Day Now
programme.desc: Los Angeles, alla fine degli anni '70. Rudy Donatello lavora come drag queen in un locale a West Hollywood. Una notte, dopo il suo spettacolo, incontra Paul Fleiger, e presto diventano una coppia. Quando Marco Deleon, un ragazzo di 14 anni affetto dalla sindrome di Down, viene abbandonato dalla madre tossicodipendente, Marianna, in seguito all'arresto di lei, Rudy e Paul decidono di prenderlo con loro. Tratto da una storia vera.

programme.title: Con amore, Antosha
programme.desc: Grazie a una prolifica carriera cinematografica e televisiva, Anton Yelchin ha lasciato un'eredità indelebile come attore. Attraverso i suoi diari e altri scritti, le sue fotografie, la musica originale che ha scritto e le interviste con la sua famiglia, i suoi amici e i suoi colleghi, questo film non si limita a esaminare l'impressionante carriera di Anton, ma offre un ritratto più ampio dell'uomo.

programme.title: Le Creature di Prometeo / Le Creaturei di Capucci
programme.desc: Un viaggio nell'arte di Roberto Capucci, icona della moda, dove 15 suoi bozzetti diventano straordinarie creazioni. Sulle note di Beethoven, la sua visione prende vita, celebrando la bellezza, il design e l'eleganza senza tempo.

programme.title: L'invitto
programme.desc: Dopo la morte del padre, Apu si trasferisce con la madre a Benares. Qui cresce e matura, tra le mille difficoltà di Sarbojaya che da sola deve mantenerlo a causa della scomparsa del coniuge Harithar. Dopo aver fatto ritorno nella vecchia casa Apu, oramai maturo e consapevole del suo destino, decide di intraprendere la via dello studio che lo porterà a frequentare l'università a Calcutta. Mentre si trova nella metropoli indiana le condizioni di salute della madre si aggravano: tardivo si rivelerà il suo viaggio verso la casa materna, per salutare il genitore un'ultima volta.

programme.title: LA DOPPIA VITA DI MIO MARITO
programme.desc: Una donna scopre che il marito nasconde una vita parallela e decide di indagare, ritrovandosi coinvolta in una spirale di bugie e pericolo.

programme.title: Ritorno al Lago
programme.desc: Dopo la perdita del padre, due sorelle si riuniscono nella villa al lago di famiglia e scoprono che il segreto per superare la tragedia è ricostruire la speranza sta nel guardarsi nel profondo

programme.title: LE BUGIE HANNO GLI OCCHI VERDI
programme.desc: Un contenuto diventato virale scatena una serie di conseguenze imprevedibili che mettono in pericolo reputazione e relazioni.

programme.title: LARS E UNA RAGAZZA TUTTA SUA
programme.desc: Lars è un uomo estremamente timido e isolato che sorprende tutti presentando una bambola come la propria fidanzata. La comunità sceglie di assecondarlo in un percorso inatteso di crescita e guarigione emotiva.

programme.title: Scambio di identità
programme.desc: Connie, nubile ed incinta, viaggia in direzione di Boston in treno ed incontra una giovane e facoltosa coppia di sposini in luna di miele, Hugh e Patricia. Durante il tragitto, il convoglio subisce un incidente grave e la ragazza finisce in ospedale.

programme.title: Otzi
programme.desc: Neolitico. Il clan guidato da Otzi viene attaccato per sottrarre un oggetto sacro. Rientrato all'accampamento, trova i membri della tribù brutalmente assassinati. Accecato dal dolore e dalla rabbia, ha un unico obiettivo: la vendetta!

programme.title: Souvenir d'italie
programme.desc: La storia di tre turiste straniere: l'inglese Margaret, la francese Josette e la tedesca Hilde che passano la frontiera con l'Italia per visitare il nostro Paese ma un incidente alla loro macchina le costringerà ad arrangiarsi con mezzi di fortuna.

programme.title: I complessi
programme.desc: Quirino cerca di conquistare Gabriella, amante di Alvaro, con la complessità della timidezza.

programme.title: Maps to the stars
programme.desc: La famiglia Weiss ha fatto dell'ossessione per la celebrità il proprio marchio distintivo.

programme.title: Fight Club
programme.desc: Il protagonista è un rappresentante annoiato e stanco del proprio lavoro, che non dorme più la notte. Per non cadere in depressione frequenta un gruppo di discussione di malati, grazie ai quali si sente finalmente bene.

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Hot Dog: Attacco a Berlino
programme.desc: I due ufficiali del GSG10 Luke e Theo non potrebbero essere più diversi. Ma ora devono unire le forze per salvare Mascha, la figlia di un ambasciatore che è stata rapita e per cui è stato chiesto un ingente riscatto.

programme.title: A Modern Family
programme.desc: Erasmus e Paul sono una coppia piuttosto stravagante: il primo è un conduttore di un famoso programma di cucina, prodotto dal secondo. La loro già non ordinaria relazione viene stravolta dall'arrivo improvviso del nipotino di Erasmus che va a vivere con loro...

programme.title: Equals
programme.desc: In un mondo futuro privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una nuova malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite in chi ne viene colpito, prima di essere allontanato dalla società e mai più rivisto. In tale contesto, Nia e Silas vivranno una relazione proibita.

programme.title: Amarsi sotto la pioggia
programme.desc: La giovane Casey, per rispettare l'ultimo desiderio della madre, si reca a Londra per consegnare una misteriosa lettera a Lord Richard Bredon, che però nega di averla mai conosciuta. In quest'occasione, Casey incontra il figlio di Bredon, Michael, e, inaspettamente, se ne innamora. Quando Lord Bredon scopre la loro relazione, comincia ad indagare sulla vita di Casey con lo scopo di ricattarla.

programme.title: Un appuntamento con il destino
programme.desc: Jack, uno sceneggiatore in crisi, incontra per caso Maria, una donna affascinante e superstiziosa che crede fermamente nelle previsioni della sua veggente. Tra rituali, superstizioni e una famiglia invadente, la loro relazione sembra destinata al caos. Eppure, Jack scopre che l'amore può sfidare anche il destino. Ma riusciranno a superare le differenze culturali delle loro famiglie?

programme.title: La lingua dell'amore
programme.desc: Dottorato in linguistica la studentessa Julie, può parlare quasi tutte le lingue che puoi immaginare. Le cose si capovolgono per Julie quando il bel Dan la contatta per prendere delle lezioni di francese. Le scintille volano presto: potrebbe essere questa la loro coppia perfetta?

programme.title: Due cuori e una baita
programme.desc: La maniaca del lavoro Jillian eredita una bellissima baita di montagna dopo la morte del suo ricco zio. Ha intenzione di venderlo, ma il bel custode Liam le fa un'offerta che non può rifiutare e le scintille volano mentre lavorano per trasformare la capanna in un resort. Ma quando gli affari non vanno secondo i piani, Jillian rinuncerà a tutto per l'amore che non ha mai visto arrivare?

programme.title: La ricerca del vero amore
programme.desc: Becks, una giornalista romantica decide di aiutare il suo migliore amico Casey alla ricerca del suo primo amore. In questo viaggio, entrambi scoprono di più l'uno dell'altro e Becks deve affrontare un dilemma: aiutare Casey o rischiare di aprirle il cuore.

programme.title: L'algoritmo dell'amore
programme.desc: Quando Liz, un'insegnante di economia, accetta un posto alla Faraday High, si offre volontaria per organizzare il Giorno del Carnevale. Viene accoppiata con l'allenatore di tennis Ted e, sebbene inizialmente abbiano difficoltà a concordare su molte cose, tra di loro scoccano scintille.

programme.title: Un amore ritrovato
programme.desc: Una giovane vedova torna a casa per la prima volta in tre anni per aiutare a preparare il matrimonio della sorella. È costretta ad affrontare il suo passato, incluso l'uomo per cui non si aspettava di innamorarsi.

programme.title: Una festa da sogno
programme.desc: Kelly è una giovane, creativa e ambiziosa pianificatrice di eventi a New York e sta rapidamente guadagnando reputazione come una delle migliori nel settore. Ma quando Joe, un editore di siti web testardo, difficile ma influente, la assume per organizzare il compleanno della nipote di 10 anni, Kelly si rende rapidamente conto di aver appena incontrato il suo match.

programme.title: Sono affari di famiglia
programme.desc: Un ex professore offre ad Adam un milione di dollari per ottenere del plasma dal laboratorio di una società di alta tecnologia. Adam chiede aiuto al nonno criminale. Riusciranno a convincere il ora onesto padre di Adam a unirsi?

programme.title: Una bugia per amore
programme.desc: Innamorato di una donna ebrea, un uomo decide di fingersi un membro della comunità ebraica allo scopo di conquistarla.

programme.title: Chalet Girl
programme.desc: Kim, da vero maschiaccio, è stata una campionessa di skateboard ma ha dovuto abbandonare i suoi sogni di gloria per trovare lavoro presso un fast food e mantenere se stessa e il padre.

programme.title: Il fiume delle verità
programme.desc: In questa coinvolgente storia d'amore un ventenne ribelle abbandona casa per andare a vivere in solitudine sulle rive di un fiume bellissimo ma selvaggio e quello che trova non è solo se stesso ma anche il vero amore.

programme.title: Vuoi cucinare con me?
programme.desc: Il comproprietario di un impero di fast-food scopre una cittadina del New Mexico dove i buongustai sbavano davanti alle prelibatezze culinarie di una bella ed esuberante cuoca.

programme.title: Maschile Singolare
programme.desc: Antonio è costretto a mettere in discussione tutte le proprie certezze quando viene abbandonato dal marito, dal quale dipende sia psicologicamente che economicamente. Deve quindi trovare una nuova casa, un lavoro e un nuovo scopo nella vita.

programme.title: Workers
programme.desc: Sandro e Filippo sono proprietari dell'agenzia interinale "Workers", praticamente trovano lavoro alle persone. Davanti a loro scorre gente di ogni tipo a caccia di impiego, personaggi pittoreschi e disoccupati pronti a tutto.

programme.title: Omicidi in serie
programme.desc: Dopo essere stata abbandonata dall'editore, Hannah Ryan decide di scrivere un giallo da pubblicare settimanalmente. Quando un omicidio sembra essere ispirato a una delle sue storie, la donna inizia a chiedersi se si tratti di una coincidenza.

programme.title: L'odore della notte
programme.desc: Remo Guerra è un poliziotto dalla doppia vita. Durante la notte è a capo di un gruppo di rapinatori dell'estrema periferia di Roma che commette diverse rapine nelle case dei ricchi.

programme.title: L'amore fa male
programme.desc: A volte l'amore fa male, ma a volte bisogna avere il coraggio di cambiare le cose e concedersi una nuova possibilità di essere felici.

programme.title: La ricetta perfetta
programme.desc: Un esperto culinario ha il compito di elevare la personalità del marchio di un canale alimentare. Mentre le loro personalità si scontrano, iniziano a rendersi conto che il contrasto può essere positivo tanto in amore quanto lo è nel cibo.

programme.title: Crazy In Love
programme.desc: Donald e Isabel sono affetti dalla sindrome di Asperger. Gli stravolgerà la vita e lui non potrà che innamorarsene perdutamente.

programme.title: I consigli di zia Hope
programme.desc: Audrey si reca a Hope Cove per scrivere di una rubrica di consigli sull'amore speciale ma anonima. Mentre è lì, incontra il redattore capo, Morgan Cooper. Presto scoppieranno scintille tra di loro. Audrey sarà la protagonista della sua storia d'amore?

programme.title: Addestramento DAmore
programme.desc: Quando una scrittice di romanzi incontra un uomo della Marina, per una ricerca per il suo prossimo libro, viene colpita dalla sua forte personalità. Sceglierà di sposare l'uomo che pensava di amare o la versione reale del suo personaggio fittizio?

programme.title: Un Matrimonio Da Salvare
programme.desc: Billie è l'affascinante proprietaria di una società di donazioni di matrimoni. I suoi clienti, Max e Jess, annullano il matrimonio. Billie e Charlie, i fratelli di Max, dovranno lavorare insieme per far sposare questa coppia.

programme.title: Louis van Beethoven Louis van Beethoven
programme.desc: Beethoven ha sempre avuto tre passioni: la musica, la libertà e la verità.

programme.title: Louis van Beethoven
programme.desc: Beethoven ha sempre avuto tre passioni: la musica, la libertà e la verità.

programme.title: Lezioni di sogni Lezioni di sogni
programme.desc: Il professor Konrad Koch insegna ai suoi studenti a giocare a calcio mentre parlano inglese.

programme.title: Kung fu Mamma Kung fu Mamma
programme.desc: Un agente segreto in pensione torna in servizio per fermare un trafficante d'armi.

programme.title: Kung fu Mamma
